name: Sofa facing the play area, console drop zone by the stairs, two TROFAST and the LÄTT on the play floor
notes:
Alternative: No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The KIVIK faces east across the coffee table to Maddie's play area, so the grown-ups watch her play; its back is to the stair side, with the LACK console behind it as the drop zone, facing the walkway along the stairs. A POÄNG at the coffee table's south end faces the window, closing an L, and the floor lamp stands in the L's corner. The group sits on the strip the drawn stair band used to keep clear, so the play floor in the sofa's view is 92" wide (56" before): the SMÅSTAD reading bench and a TROFAST on the upper section, a second TROFAST in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, the LEN rug and the LÄTT table.
sofa-1 KIVIK facing east, rot 270, x 51.375-88.75, y 40-129.75: its north arm 34" from the heater face (F-33), so a 34" route runs along the window from the top landing; the console and the 36" walkway along the stairs behind it (F-39); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
console-1 LACK console, x 36-51.375, y 57.312-112.438, against the sofa's back and facing the walkway along the stairs: the drop zone where you step off them; lamp-2 STORSEGEL on top, four GNABBAS baskets for keys, mail, hats and shoes on its shelf; plant-1 FEJKA at its north end (x 38-47, y 46-55).
coffee-table-1 LACK turned 90 degrees, x 104.75-126.375, y 60.875-96.25: 16" in front of the sofa (F-39).
chair-1 POÄNG facing north at the coffee table's south end, x 102.188-128.938, y 110.25-142.5: 14" from the coffee table, its back 0.5" short of the open side's walkway (F-42); side-table-1 LACK with lamp-1 STORSEGEL beside it (x 130-151.625, y 120.875-142.5); floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP in the L's corner (x 90-99, y 131-140).
rug-1 TIOKRONA turned 90 degrees, 94 x 118", x 36-130, y 24.5-142.5: the console, the plant, the sofa, the coffee table, the POÄNG and the TÅGARP stand fully on it, the sofa with 15.5" of rug past its north arm and 12.75" past its south arm; the side table stands off its edge; two STOPP FILT underlays under it keep it from sliding.
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375, 12" from the heater face (F-33), its boxes keep 24" (F-32); wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
toy-storage-1 TROFAST, right-upper wall x 243.625-261, y 56.375-93, with art-2 RÖDALM centered above it, where the sofa looks; toy-storage-2 TROFAST, right-lower wall x 258.125-275.5, y 96-132.625, 10.4" short of the open side's walkway (F-42), with art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies centered above it and wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS centered above the picture (center about 66" up, out of her reach from the floor, its cord in a cover down behind the TROFAST): 24" clear in front of each (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed.
rug-3 LEN play rug, x 168-220, y 56-119; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 180-204.75, y 100-118.875: outside both TROFAST's 24" (F-32), 28" from the side table, in the sofa's line of sight.
Right side (F-61): the 93" right-upper wall carries the SMÅSTAD and a TROFAST, the right-lower wall the second TROFAST (36 5/8" of the 50" left of the walkway).
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21); the BISSA shoe cabinet, which stood free at the console's end (it has to be anchored to a wall, F-21, and the stair side is a railing, not a wall: shoes go in a fourth GNABBAS basket on the console's shelf); the PERJOHAN entry bench, hooks and LOHALS hall rug (the bottom wall the entry stood on is open; the console by the walkway along the stairs is the entry now); the BESTÅ cabinets (a, d), the KALLAX units (c, d), the chaise sofa (c), the KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE (d), the kid's POÄNG (c, d) and the FLISAT (a, c, d), the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. The stair side is a railing (Andrew, 2026-10-24), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included (y 0-36 and y 137-173): it is the walkway between the stairs' two ends, and nothing Maddie can climb stands at the railing (F-40, F-21). The bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there, nothing stands under it (F-38), and no art hangs on that wall.
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open, so they are gone; the console by the walkway along the stairs is the drop zone. The LILJETRÄD mirror that moved to the window wall above the top landing is off the plan too: it is glass (F-21).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; no storage over 27"; the console and the plant stand 36" from the railing, at the strip's edge.
Power: the stair side is a railing and the bottom side is open, so outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are is not recorded. The UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords run down the play wall in cord covers. The group stands 40" or more from the nearest wall, so its three lamps need flat floor cord covers to the window wall, crossing the route along the window well east of the top landing, never across the strip along the railing or the open side's walkway and never under the rug; the TÅGARP's cord is 3' 3", so it needs an extension, or a cordless lamp in its place.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x4 (console shelf), STOPP FILT underlays x2 (under the TIOKRONA).
Audit 2026-10-24: the LILJETRÄD mirror is off the plan, because it is glass and F-21 allows none. The TIOKRONA moved 6" toward the stairs and 0.5" toward the open side, so the console, the plant and the POÄNG stand fully on it instead of across its edges, and two STOPP FILT underlays keep it from sliding, as in the dining room. The RÖDALM left the window wall, where it hung over the heater and behind the curtains' stack, for the first TROFAST, where the sofa looks: the sofa faced the play wall with nothing on its line of sight. A VARPTROSS wall lamp, the dining room's bamboo sconce, over the Waterlilies gives the play area its own light. These notes now record the railing (F-40), the lamp cords and the fourth GNABBAS basket.
